step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage CMOS Operational Amplifier with RC Miller Compensation (Zero-Nulling Resistor Rz)
step1_figure.description: The netlist implements the classic two-stage operational amplifier of Fig. 24.8 connected in unity-gain feedback with Cc = 2.4 pF and Rz = 6.5 kΩ driving a load capacitance of 1 pF, matching the large-signal and small-signal step response test configurations in Fig. 24.14 (p. 782) and Fig. 24.23 (p. 788).

equation.explanation: Product of the first-stage differential gain and second-stage common-source gain.
equation.assumptions: Transistors operate in saturation with finite output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_D1 = 10 uA, g_m1 ≈ 150 uS, r_o1 ≈ 500 kΩ (gain stage 1 ≈ 75 = 37.5 dB); second stage I_D7 = 10 uA, g_m7 ≈ 100 uS, r_o2 ≈ 500 kΩ (gain stage 2 ≈ 50 = 34 dB). Total A_OLDC ≈ 60 to 70 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard two-stage CMOS op-amp topology provides 55-65 dB DC gain in 180nm/130nm processes.

equation.explanation: Determined by input diff-pair transconductance and compensation capacitance Cc.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole approximation with zero cancelled by Rz.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For 20 uA tail current (10 uA per branch) and 2.4 pF Miller capacitor, GBW is around 10-12 MHz.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop response at unity-gain frequency

equation.explanation: Nulling resistor Rz = 6.5 kΩ cancels the RHP zero or pushes it into LHP, enhancing phase margin.

sky130_expected.calculation: With dominant pole at ~10 kHz, secondary pole beyond 30 MHz, and zero cancelled by Rz = 6.5 kΩ, PM = 180 - 90 - arctan(10M/35M) ≈ 74°.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard Miller compensation designed for >60° phase margin.

slew_rate_positive.description: Positive output slew rate when charging Cc

equation.explanation: When non-inverting input jumps high, the diff-pair tail current Iss charges Cc.
equation.assumptions: Tail current Iss = 20 uA fully steers to charge Cc.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Explicitly calculated in text on page 787 as 20 uA / 2.4 pF = 8.3 mV/ns.

slew_rate_negative.description: Negative output slew rate when discharging Cc + CL through M8

equation.explanation: When input drops, second-stage bias current IM8 must discharge both Cc and CL.
equation.assumptions: M7 shuts off and constant current source M8 (10 uA) discharges Cc + CL.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Explicitly stated on page 788 as roughly 3 mV/ns (3 V/us).

settling_time_rise.description: Low-to-high settling time for 400 mV step

equation.explanation: Time required for the output to settle within 1% of final value on rising step.

sky130_expected.calculation: Slew time = 400 mV / 8.3 V/us ≈ 48 ns + small-signal settling ≈ 100 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Caption of Fig. 24.23 specifies low-to-high settling time is roughly 100 ns.

settling_time_fall.description: High-to-low settling time for 400 mV step (slew-rate limited)

equation.explanation: Discharging time dominated by 3 V/us slew rate plus gate-voltage recovery of M7.
equation.assumptions: Includes gate undershoot recovery period discussed on page 788.

sky130_expected.calculation: Slewing takes 400 mV / 2.94 V/us = 136 ns; undershoot recovery adds ~350 ns, totaling ~500 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Caption of Fig. 24.23 states high-to-low settling time is roughly 500 ns.

cmrr.description: Common-Mode Rejection Ratio at low frequency

equation.explanation: Ratio of differential gain to common-mode gain, set by diff-pair and tail source impedance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Cascode tail source provides high output impedance (R_tail ~ 1 MΩ), giving CMRR ≈ 50 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Page 789 states 'For the op-amps discussed so far in this chapter, the CMRR is approximately 50 dB'.

psrr_plus.description: Power Supply Rejection Ratio from positive rail VDD at DC

equation.explanation: Ratio of open-loop gain to supply noise gain. At DC, v_out/v+ ≈ 1 (0 dB), so PSRR+ ≈ A_OLDC.
equation.assumptions: Evaluated at DC / low frequency (10 Hz).

sky130_expected.calculation: A_OLDC ≈ 62 dB and v_out/v+ ≈ 0 dB -> PSRR+ ≈ 62 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: As explained on page 791, noise on VDD feeds through M7 gate-source to output with unity gain at DC.

power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent power consumption at VDD = 1.8V

equation.explanation: Total static power drawn from the 1.8V power supply rail.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent state with input CM at 0.7V.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_diff = 20 uA, I_stage2 = 10 uA, I_bias ~ 70 uA (7 branches in bias circuit). Total I_DD ≈ 100 uA * 1.8V ≈ 180 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Op-amp core draws 30 uA, bias generator SUB_1 draws ~70 uA.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice testbench characterizing DC power, AC open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, CMRR, PSRR+, and transient slew rate and settling times.
